offers.t: RF RAN mobile radio networks Engineer
offers.sn: A team of RF network planners who provide support to the regional system engineering teams throughout EMEA. The support includes a) pre-sale planning (including proposal development)
offers.rq: Suitable candidates will have 3+ years of experience in planning mobile radio networks (either commercial mobile phone networks or private LMR networks). Successful candidates are likely to hold a BSc or higher Degree in a Telecommunications related subject. Fluent in spoken and written Polish and English
